title: DER bridge via aliased dep is clean and explicitly removable
description: Using package alias (x509-cert-stable = { package = 'x509-cert', version = '0.2' }) to coexist with the rc stack is idiomatic Cargo. The bridge in bridge_cert is 4 lines, isolated, and the comment explicitly says it is removable when pkix upgrades. A contributor might suggest removing it 'to simplify' before pkix is ready — the comment is the defence.
